title: Visit to the Antikythera mechanism

tellings.quote: I recently went to Athens, Greece to see the the Antikythera mechanism.

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a property famous for reports of strange events, says he recently went to Athens, Greece, to see the Antikythera mechanism, an ancient geared device found in the sea. He tells it as his own trip, in an episode where he speaks about the ranch. In his words: "I recently went to Athens, Greece to see the Antikythera mechanism."
